# Text (Short Free Text) (`text`)

## Use when

When responses are free text that cannot be meaningfully pre-categorised, or when exploring unknown topics exploratively.

## Cross-format mapping

| Format | Value |
|--------|-------|
| XLSForm typeString | `text` |
| LimeSurvey type code | `S` |
| DDI `intrvl` | `discrete` |
| DDI `responseDomainType` | `text` |
| DDI `varFormat/@type` | `character` |

## Lifecycle across the ecosystem

```mermaid
graph LR
    XLS["XLSForm row<br/>type: text"]
    LS["LS TSV<br/>type/scale: S"]
    DDI["DDI XML<br/>&lt;var intrvl=discrete<br/>responseDomainType=text&gt;"]
    XLS -->|xlsform2lstsv| LS
    LS -->|lstsv2xlsform| XLS
    XLS -->|xlsform2ddi| DDI
    LS -->|lstsv2ddi| DDI
```

DDI is the terminus: it describes the dataset, not the instrument, so there is no
path back out of it (see `src/pipelines/README.md`).

## Constraints

- Variable name ≤ 20 chars, pattern `^[a-zA-Z0-9]+$`
